notes: Method (forked from mexicat/pdoom-video's analysis/analyze.py; adapted for this song, see analysis/README-whatif.md): tempo is constant, 73.981 BPM (period 0.81102 s), fitted on drum+mix onset envelopes over a 60-90 BPM search (pdoom's script instead searched a known 125-138 BPM DAW-tempo range), phase refined on kick attack times (first beat 0.274 s); the drums stem is silent until ~80s and after ~155s (this song's drums only play under 'storm'..'dark'), but the mix onset envelope carries the beat through the drum-less sections. Bar phase (downbeat = every 4th beat) was picked automatically from beat-synchronous chroma novelty on the bass+other stems (chord changes land on downbeats): first downbeat 1.085 s; pdoom instead hand-verified bar phase from a known chord chart. Sections: this song has no verse/chorus form with a bar-numbered chord chart like pdoom's, so each chapter (data/lyrics.json line groups, matching docs/TREATMENT.md's chapter table) starts at the downbeat at or before its first line's CTC-aligned start (folding in a short instrumental pickup), and runs to the next chapter's start; 'book' (0 -> first chapter) and 'close' (last chapter's end -> duration) are the instrumental intro/outro. Envelopes: 100 fps, frame i centred at i/100 s, 46 ms RMS window, one-pole smoothing (10 ms attack / 90 ms release), each divided by its own 99th percentile and clipped to 0..1 (linear amplitude). low <150 Hz, mid 150-2000 Hz, high >4 kHz of the full mix; vocal/drums/bass/other = stem RMS. Onsets [time, strength 0-1] from the drums stem: kick = attack (steepest rise) of the <120 Hz band (131); snare = 1.5-5 kHz attacks whose 0.5-5 kHz noise tail 40-120 ms later is in the loudest local class (51); hat = >7 kHz attacks not within 40 ms of a snare or 30 ms of a kick (71). All three are sparse and only present from ~80s to ~155s (see above). vocal = note onsets from the vocal stem (log-mel flux peaks + legato pitch jumps > 0.8 semitone), including backing vocals / held-note re-articulations.
